name: fmla-leave
title: FMLA leave administration
summary: Apply the US Family and Medical Leave Act regulations to one employee's situation: eligibility, coverage, leave used and left, 12-month periods, military caregiver leave, and notice and certification deadlines.
description: Each task gives the facts about one unnamed employee and employer: dates, hours, head counts and leave already taken. The AI reads the Department of Labor's FMLA regulations, 29 CFR Part 825, and answers what they decide: whether the employee is eligible and the employer covered, how much leave is used and left in workweeks and hours, a deadline as a date, or whether a step complies. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Employer coverage
families.what: Whether a private employer is covered, counting employees and workweeks, and how long coverage lasts.

families.name: Eligibility
families.what: Whether an employee is eligible, on the right date for each test, with hours of service and breaks in service.

families.name: Leave used
families.what: Intermittent and reduced-schedule leave as a fraction of the employee's own workweek, for part-time and varying schedules.

families.name: Holidays and overtime
families.what: How holidays, a shutdown and required or voluntary overtime count against the leave.

families.name: The 12-month period
families.what: The leave left under the calendar-year, fixed-year, forward and rolling methods, and when leave comes back.

families.name: Military caregiver leave
families.what: The single 12-month period and its combined limit with other leave.

families.name: Spouses with one employer
families.what: The combined limits for spouses with the same employer, and the leave each keeps.

families.name: Notice deadlines
families.what: The employer's and the employee's notice deadlines as dates, counted in business or calendar days.

families.name: Certification
families.what: Time to return and to cure a medical certification, the effect of a late one, and when recertification may be asked.

families.name: Special rules
families.what: The rules for school teachers near the end of a term and for airline flight crews.
